preconditions.description: The number of rows n is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of columns m is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The total number of cells n * m is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f[i][j] <= n * m for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each level of silence f[i][j] is between 1 and n * m inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(set(f[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(m))) == n * m
preconditions.description: All levels of silence f[i][j] are distinct.

postconditions.description: The number of pleasant segments of silence is between 0 and the maximum possible number of segments.
